name: ClawArmor
description: ClawArmor security guard for OpenClaw - protects against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and malicious commands. Includes Evolve adaptive defense that auto-generates and evolves detection rules.

enabled.description: Enable or disable ClawArmor guard (default: true)

blockOnCritical.description: Block requests when critical risk is detected (default: true)

blockOnHighRisk.description: Block requests when high risk is detected (default: false)

logAllChecks.description: Log all security checks for debugging (default: false)

externalApiThreshold.description: Threshold for external API risk scoring (default: 0.8)

maskSensitiveData.description: Mask sensitive data like credentials in logs (default: true)

apiEndpoint.description: External API endpoint for secondary validation (optional)

apiKey.description: API key for external validation service (optional)

evolveEnabled.description: Enable Evolve adaptive defense - auto-generates detection rules from attacks (default: true)

evolveDbPath.description: Path to store Evolve event database (default: ~/.openclaw/clawarmor/events.db)

evolveRulesPath.description: Path to store Evolve rules JSON file (default: ~/.openclaw/clawarmor/rules.json)

evolveUpdateInterval.description: Number of events before triggering an evolution cycle (default: 5)

evolveLlmApiBase.description: LLM API base URL for rule generation (default: DashScope)

evolveLlmApiKey.description: LLM API key for rule generation

evolveLlmModel.description: LLM model name for rule generation (default: qwen3-max)

evolveTargetFpRate.description: Target false positive rate for adaptive threshold (default: 0.05)

evolveTargetFnRate.description: Target false negative rate for adaptive threshold (default: 0.02)
